name: Zone Raids
summary: Extraction shooter in the style of Escape from Tarkov and S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: raids with extraction, limb damage, loot, artifacts and anomalies.
_comment: side: both | client | server. If omitted, it is taken from Modrinth (server_side=unsupported -> client). version: exact Modrinth version_number to pin; omitted = newest release for Forge 1.20.1 at build time (the resolved list is saved to mods.lock.json in the build output).

mods.why: TaCZ: guns, attachments, ammo
Limb damage, bandages, morphine. Original First Aid, because TaCZ FirstAid Compat depends on it
Bullets hit the limb they land on, armor per body part
Armed bandits and soldiers using TaCZ guns
Military gear: armor sets, plates, backpacks, rigs, NVG
Required by Fracture Point models
Accessory slots: artifacts, gear
Anomalies, emissions, detectors, artifacts. Version 1.2 = file 2.0.0-pre-release; 2.0 (file 3.0.0) crashes dedicated servers in QuestNetwork
Required by Anomaly Zone
Grappling hook
Leaning around corners, prone, slide, third-person reload and gun-holding animations made for TaCZ (pulls PlayerAnimator)
Climbing over 2-block obstacles and rolls on vanilla keys; its slide, crawl and dodges are off in config (TACtical Movement and TaCZ cover them)
Camera tilt and sway when strafing, turning and landing
Proximity voice chat, key for extraction shooters
Reverb and muffling, atmosphere
Custom main menu
Item lookup for admins building loot tables
Less RAM, faster startup, fixes world leaks
Less RAM
Fast renderer (Sodium port)
Shader packs (Iris port for Forge, works on top of Embeddium); TaCZ supports it. Zone Raids moves its R/K keys off TaCZ reload and the terminal
Skips rendering of hidden entities and block entities
Faster HUD, text and entity rendering
TPS/FPS profiler and heap summaries

mods.name: AllTheLeaks
mods.why: Fixes known memory leaks in Forge, Minecraft and popular mods (CurseForge only, file 8779054)

_shaderpacks_comment: Client only, into shaderpacks/. default = turned on in config/oculus.properties. settings = shaderpacks/<zip>.txt, option names are listed by modpack/tools/shader_options.py (report/shader-options.txt).

shaderpacks.why: Lightest good-looking pack, made for weak and integrated GPUs; tuned for a grey, foggy Zone
